features.introText: We digitize the property search and sale process, saving time and money for both buyers and sellers.
features.f1Text: Buyers explore every room as if they were there in person.
features.f2Text: Instantly calculates monthly payments with or without government subsidy.
features.f3Text: Uzbek, Russian, and English — reach a wider audience.
features.f4Text: Every new listing is reviewed by our team to ensure trust.
features.f5Text: Phone, tablet, or computer — smooth on any device.
features.f6Text: Posting a listing takes minutes, at no cost.
features.step1Text: Create a free account in seconds.
features.step2Text: Add details and photos, include a 360° tour.
features.step3Text: Interested buyers reach out to you directly.
